$comment: Policy for check:ci-literal-sources (.ci/rediacc_ci/quality/literal_sources.py). The VALUES live in .ci/config/well-known.env and regions.json; this file says which namespaces are owned, what is out of scope and why, which files may carry a value they cannot import, and how each language spells the symbol. Every exemption and carrier carries a reason, and R3 fails on one that no longer matches anything.

thresholds.$comment: R2a: an unregistered owned literal in CODE in this many distinct files must be registered. R2b: the same for a third-party URL stem or image repository. R5_distance: the edit distance under which an unequal owned host or address is a near miss of a registered one (scaled down for short labels).

scope.$comment: Files lexed as CODE. Everything else tracked (markdown, html, svg, ...) is read as PROSE for R5 only.

reserved.$comment: Names that never count, because they are reserved by a standard and cannot be anybody's configuration.

suffixes.reason: XML/SVG namespace URIs are identifiers, not endpoints
JSON Schema dialect identifiers, not endpoints

sources.$comment: Files that ARE the definition. They are not scanned; the keys say which entries they define.
